frozen_inputs.business_expression: 我是开雪茄馆的，该怎么起号？

topic_questions: 丘吉尔与雪茄之间的公共关联中，品牌偏好与'丘吉尔'格式命名这两条线索如何分别形成、又如何交织？
古巴在雪茄产业中的核心产区地位是如何由其地理条件、产量分布和品牌使用关系构成的？
美国对古巴贸易禁运如何在产品流通、商标归属和国际政治三个层面持续影响雪茄的命运？
manual_observations: The Churchill path produced a concrete, evidence-referenced preference and format-naming question rather than a category heading.
The embargo reading surfaced Kennedy's pre-embargo cigar purchase, but final convergence chose a broader trade topic and dropped the most vivid event-level entry.
Search-result snippets were kept distinct from primary-source evidence; source authority remained mixed.

diagnosis.passing_stage: Evidence-bounded reading can turn a frozen named path into a concrete TopicBrief.
diagnosis.failing_stage: Model-first candidate recall and ordering favored the most salient association and omitted the held-out person.
diagnosis.architectural_bottleneck: Search occurred only after candidate names were frozen, so retrieval could verify or enrich a recalled path but could not reliably introduce an omitted path.
measurement_limitations: This is one user-gold development case, not a generalization evaluation.
Only the first four candidates were searched and only the first three evidence-bearing paths were read; those limits were evaluation budgets, not validated product defaults.
The evidence pack contains bounded search snippets rather than opened and independently verified primary sources.

post_run_verification.scope: E40, E39, active content-world explorer, and active business-semantics tests
